title: Breast Feeding Tracker Privacy Policy
htmlContent:
Breast Feeding Tracker is designed to support parents with simple feeding logs while respecting privacy.

Data Collection

Your feeding log is stored on your device. If you enable iCloud synchronisation or sharing in an app version that supports it, the selected records are also processed through Apple’s iCloud to provide those features. The purchase, analytics and advertising services described below do not receive a copy of your full feeding log.

How Data Is Used

Your feeding information is used to provide timeline history, summaries, and in-app insights for you. We do not send your feeding records to Kickstart Exchange.

Purchases and Restores: RevenueCat

Apple processes payments for in-app purchases. We use RevenueCat to validate purchases, restore access and manage purchased features. RevenueCat receives purchase receipts or transaction information, such as product and transaction identifiers, purchase dates, prices, currency, purchase or refund status, and app and device context such as the platform, app version and storefront country.

RevenueCat uses a randomly generated app customer identifier. The app also sends RevenueCat its TelemetryDeck app identifier and a hashed analytics identifier so that purchase events can be measured alongside app usage. We do not send your name, email address, baby’s name or full feeding records to RevenueCat. We do not receive your payment-card details or Apple Account password.

For more information, read RevenueCat’s privacy policy.

App Analytics: TelemetryDeck

We use TelemetryDeck to understand how the app is used and where it fails. Events can include opening a screen, using a timer, saving an activity, completing onboarding, viewing a purchase screen, or the result of a purchase or restore. Event context can include the feature or activity type, feeding side, duration and volume ranges, counts, settings choices, and bounded error or result categories. These ranges are feeding-related information even though they are less detailed than your log.

TelemetryDeck also receives technical context such as the app version, operating system, device model, language and region. Its SDK hashes the device’s vendor identifier before sending it, and TelemetryDeck describes a further hashing step on its servers. Some measurement events use a separate randomly generated installation or attempt identifier, also hashed before transmission.

The app does not send baby names, free-text notes, complete feeding entries, exact recorded feeding times or your mailing-list email address to TelemetryDeck. RevenueCat can forward purchase events to TelemetryDeck using the hashed analytics identifier described above. These services are used to measure this app, not to build profiles for tracking you across other companies’ apps or websites.

For more information, read TelemetryDeck’s privacy policy and its privacy FAQ.

Measuring Apple Ads Acquisition

In app versions with Apple Ads attribution enabled, the RevenueCat SDK obtains an attribution token from Apple’s AdServices framework and sends it to RevenueCat. RevenueCat exchanges the token with Apple to learn whether Apple attributes the app installation to one of our ads. Where available, the resulting information can include campaign, ad group, keyword, country or region, and whether the installation was a download or redownload.

We associate this campaign information with the RevenueCat customer and purchase history to understand whether our advertising leads to purchases. The app uses standard AdServices attribution without requesting access to the advertising identifier (IDFA) or requesting App Tracking Transparency permission for detailed attribution. Feeding records are not sent to Apple Ads or RevenueCat for this measurement.

For more information, see Apple Advertising & Privacy.

Optional Mailing List

If you choose to join our mailing list in the app, the first name and email address you submit are sent to Kit to provide the updates you requested. Joining is optional and does not affect feeding tools or purchased access. We do not attach these contact details to the RevenueCat customer or TelemetryDeck analytics identifier.

You can unsubscribe using the link in a mailing-list email. Read Kit’s privacy policy for its handling of subscriber information.

Advertising: Kickstart Exchange

The free version of Breast Feeding Tracker uses the Kickstart Exchange SDK to display adverts for other independent apps. Kickstart Exchange is operated by Hudson Heavy Industries Ltd.

To deliver adverts, check compatibility, measure app promotion, and protect the service from misuse, the SDK sends information about the app: its integration key, bundle identifier, platform, app and build versions, SDK version, and App Store country. The country comes from your App Store account’s storefront setting, not GPS location.

Kickstart Exchange records advert displays, clicks, and any advert reports you submit. These are app-level advertising and product-interaction records, rather than records linked to your identity. Tapping an advert opens the advertised app’s App Store page.

In release builds, the SDK may also send an Apple-signed App Transaction to verify a genuine installation. This can contain stable transaction and device-verification values. Kickstart states that it uses this signed evidence only for verification and immediately discards it, without retaining or using those values to identify, profile, or target you.

Kickstart’s network provider, Cloudflare, processes your IP address to deliver and secure requests, including advert artwork. Kickstart states that it does not store these addresses or use them to identify users.

Kickstart retains individual app-level advert delivery and interaction records for approximately 30 days. Aggregate daily app-to-app statistics are retained without a fixed deletion date. These statistics do not identify individual users or devices.

For further details, read the Kickstart Exchange privacy notice.

Sharing and Tracking

Breast Feeding Tracker does not sell your feeding records or use them to personalise adverts. Kickstart Exchange states that it does not track users across apps or websites or build behavioural profiles.

Your Choices

Lifetime Unlock removes Kickstart Exchange advert banners from the app. You can purchase or restore Lifetime Unlock in the app.

You can delete feeding entries in the app. Uninstalling the app can remove its local data; records stored in iCloud or shared with others may need to be managed separately through the relevant app and iCloud controls. Removing the app does not automatically delete purchase, analytics or mailing-list records held by service providers.

Purchase and acquisition records are retained as needed to provide purchased access, handle restores, support and refunds, and measure the app’s performance. Analytics and subscriber records are subject to the providers’ retention practices. Contact us about access, correction or deletion requests; we may need information to locate the relevant record, and some purchase records may need to be retained to provide access or meet legal obligations.

Contact

If you have any questions, contact support@scruffyhipster.com.
